world.title: 相差 0.1° 的双摆轨迹
world.posterTitle: 差 0.1° 的两次放手，为什么结局完全不同？
world.posterHook: 拖摆球设定初始角，释放后看紫色影子摆（仅差 0.1°）多久与主摆彻底分叉。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · RK4 双摆 · 本地构建
world.question: 两次几乎相同的放手，为什么走出完全不同的路？
world.hook: 释放双摆，旁边的影子摆初始角只偏 0.1°。盯住分离角：它起初纹丝不动，然后突然爆炸。
world.payoff: 混沌：方程完全确定，但初值误差被指数放大（李雅普诺夫指数 > 0），长期行为必然不可预测——确定性不等于可预测。

en.title: Double-pendulum paths starting 0.1° apart
en.posterTitle: Why are the two letting gos with a difference of 0.1° completely different endings?
en.posterHook: Drag the pendulum ball to set the initial angle. After releasing it, see how long it takes for the purple shadow pendulum (with a difference of only 0.1°) to completely diverge from the main pendulum.
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · RK4 Double Pendulum · Local Build
en.question: Two almost identical letting gos, why take completely different paths?
en.hook: When the double pendulum is released, the initial angle of the shadow pendulum next to it is only 0.1°. Keep an eye on the separation angle: it's motionless at first, then suddenly explodes.
en.payoff: Chaos: The equation is completely determined, but the initial value error is exponentially amplified (Lyapunov index > 0), and the long-term behavior is necessarily unpredictable - certainty does not equal predictability.
